objective_for_doctor:
Age: 9
Sex: Female
Chief Complaint: I have a fever, sensitive pain, and exhausting pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi—I've had a fever with chills, and I feel very tired. I also have painful, sensitive pain on my head (back, top, and forehead) and my muscles feel sore all over. The pain is mostly in the back/right side of my neck, and I have pink red skin lesions there that are a bit swollen and mildly itchy.
[ASK] Do you have a high fever (≥ 38.0°C) with a new cough or sore throat that started within the last 7 days?
I have fever, but I don’t have a cough or sore throat that I can say started in the last 7 days.
[ASK] Does the patient have a high fever with a cough (or coughing fits) and shortness of breath?
No, I don’t have a cough or shortness of breath.
[ASK] Does the patient have a high fever with severe sore throat and difficulty swallowing/drooling (suggesting a potentially life-threatening throat infection)?
No—I don’t have severe sore throat, trouble swallowing, or drooling.
[ASK] Does the patient have a fever plus a sore throat (pain when swallowing) and symptoms that started suddenly (within the last few days)?
No, I don’t have a sore throat or pain when swallowing. It started pretty fast, but it’s mainly fever, head pain, neck pain, and muscle aches.
[ASK] Have you had a high fever (≥38.5°C) along with severe diarrhea or vomiting within the last 1–2 weeks, and have you had known exposure to someone with Ebola?
No, I don’t have severe diarrhea or vomiting, and I don’t know of any exposure to Ebola.
